lines.say: Young men are losing their grip. Literally.
In 2016, researchers tested men aged 20 to 24.
lines.show: In *2016,* researchers tested men aged 20 to 24.

lines.say: Their grip was 20 pounds weaker than men that age in 1985.
lines.show: Their grip was *20 pounds weaker* than men that age in *1985.*

lines.say: The likely reason: hands that scroll, but rarely carry, climb or hang.
lines.show: The likely reason: hands that *scroll,* but rarely carry, climb or hang.

lines.say: And grip isn't just about hands.
Across 140,000 people, every 5 kilos of grip lost came with a 16% higher risk of death.
lines.show: Across *140,000* people, every *5 kilos* of grip lost came with a *16%* higher risk of death.

lines.say: It predicted death better than blood pressure.
lines.show: It predicted death *better* than blood pressure.

lines.say: Your body keeps only what you ask of it.
lines.show: Your body keeps only what you *ask* of it.

lines.say: So ask. Hang from a bar. Carry heavy things. Train the pull-up you can't do yet.
lines.show: So *ask.* *Hang* from a bar. *Carry* heavy things. Train the *pull-up* you can't do yet.

lines.say: In 2022, I had one messy pull-up. My 12-week plan is in The Complete Fighter. Link in bio.
lines.show: In 2022, I had *one messy pull-up.* My *12-week plan* is in *The Complete Fighter.* Link in bio.
